value.rationale: A natural complete classification of nonordinary fibers in the exact moving-branch family of the primary work: the Hasse divisor is always reduced on the smooth locus, and its entire degree two either gives two smooth nonordinary curves or is absorbed at a unique singular branch collision, detected by an exact resultant. This separates support and vanishing-order data invisible to a mass formula; the distinct p-ranks at two exceptional fibers are structurally meaningful.
